products.name: Harvey AI
products.note: Legal AI assistant; contract drafting; case research; law firm data exposure; privilege concerns

profile_text.body:
Harvey is a software company focused on artificial intelligence tools for legal and professional services. The company describes itself as a platform built to meet the standards of leading professional service firms, and its site positions the product as a secure environment that allows legal professionals to focus on high-value work. Its stated areas of application include contract analysis, due diligence, compliance, and litigation support, with customers described as leading law firms and corporate legal teams worldwide.

The company's primary product is Harvey AI, a legal AI assistant used for contract drafting, case research, and related tasks. The site quotes Dr. Claudia Junker describing the platform as having transformed how her team works by enabling precision on intricate legal issues and a focus on strategic value. Harvey notes that 2025 brought new customer wins, product updates, and expanded global presence, though no specific figures or named customers are provided on the site.

The held facts note the product carries considerations around law firm data exposure and privilege concerns, which are relevant points of scrutiny for legal deployments of AI. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are on file for the company at this time.
